statement: With fixed ImageNet models and no fine-tuning, a 30-degree test gives nD-RoPE 78.51% top-1 and RoPE-Mixed 71.34%.
domain: all 50,000 ImageNet-1K validation images resized to 256, rotated 30 degrees, and center-cropped to 224
verification_rule: Exact checkpoint digests, complete transform metadata, 50,000 labeled per-example predictions, and independently recomputed top-1 values must reproduce the two metrics.
falsification_rule: A counterexample must preserve the exact fixed trained models, full validation set, and rotation pipeline and contradict the reported values or ordering.
